host_house_field_preparation_801bb2e938c.player_statement: Father, Mother, I am going now to assume the Qin field command appointed to me and receive the men placed under that command. While I am away, keep the manor and House running at full strength. Continue the training, recruitment, and manufacture of equipment. Keep building the strength of the House rather than waiting on my return. Prepare food, fodder, arrows, replacement weapons, armor, shields, tack, and other field equipment that can lawfully be spared, so supplies can follow me when the route and authority allow it. I am taking all of my troops, commanders, and officers with me. Kai, keep training. Listen to Father and Mother, learn how the House is actually run, and be ready when your own time to command comes. I am going to war now. Farewell.
